channels.title: Public channels
channels.description: Channel handles or t.me links, e.g. durov, @durov, https://t.me/durov. Private channels, groups and user profiles are not supported by design.

maxPostsPerChannel.title: Max posts per channel
maxPostsPerChannel.description: Hard cap on posts per channel. 0 means the whole readable history (can be expensive).

minDate.title: Only posts newer than
minDate.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-01-31. Pagination stops as soon as older posts appear.

searchTerms.title: Keyword filter
searchTerms.description: Keep only posts whose text contains at least one of these terms (case-insensitive). Leave empty to keep everything.

includeMediaUrls.title: Include media URLs
includeMediaUrls.description: Photo, video, voice, document and sticker URLs.

includeHtml.title: Include raw post HTML
includeHtml.description: Adds the original HTML of every post. Off by default: it roughly doubles the size of each result.

maxConcurrency.title: Channels scraped in parallel
maxConcurrency.description: How many channels to fetch at the same time (1-10). Higher is faster and cheaper in compute, but hits Telegram harder.

failOnUnreadableChannel.title: Fail the run when a channel cannot be read
failOnUnreadableChannel.description: ON (recommended): if any channel is missing, private, restricted or only partially loaded, the run ends as FAILED with a reason instead of quietly returning fewer posts. OFF: partial results are accepted and the problem is reported in the run summary only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Datacenter proxies are usually enough.
